effects.label: Action
effects.text: Reveal the opponent's Hand. Choose one card there and discard it.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: When revealed, negate one opposing Gambit. If this card is revealed with Gambits, apply this before other Gambit effects. If the opponent set no Gambit, give them disadvantage during this battle.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after you reveal one or more cards in the opponent's Hand outside a battle, then win a battle against that opponent in which they set a Gambit.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When your Active Mission would fail, you may put this card in your Graveyard to return that Mission to your Hand instead.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: If an opposing effect revealed one of your Gambits or Tactics before its normal reveal, gain advantage.

effects.label: Gambit
effects.text: When Gambits are revealed, if the opponent also set a Gambit, gain advantage. In the Aftermath, return this card to your Hand instead of putting it in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after you win a battle in which the opponent set a Gambit and you did not.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After an opposing Gambit or Tactic is revealed in a battle involving you, before the battle result is determined, you may discard this card to withdraw.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after you withdraw from a battle after an opposing Tactic was revealed.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card. When you do, reveal the opponent's Hand, choose one card there, and bind it face up beneath this card. You may have only one banked Extraordinary Rendition.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: The bound card cannot be played, moved, or affected except by this card. Whenever you discard one or more Assets you control, discard this card before any others, if able. When this card leaves play, put the bound card in its owner's Discard Pile.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Place this card as an Overlay on a Territory. Remove it after the next battle fought there. During that battle, the controller of this Territory sets their Gambit and chooses their Tactics after the opponent's corresponding choice, regardless of who initiated the battle.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, if your opponent set a Gambit and has one or more Tactics in battle, they choose one: return their Gambit to their Hand; or return each of their Tactics to its source. They have no Gambit or no Tactics in this battle, as chosen.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after your opponent has both a Gambit and one or more Tactics in a battle involving you, then loses that battle.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When an opponent forms their Reserve in a battle involving you, before they choose Tactics, you may discard this card to reveal that Reserve and choose one card. They cannot choose that card during this battle.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Before Tactics normally reveal, reveal each opposing face-down Tactic and the opponent's Reserve. Return one opposing Tactic of your choice to that Reserve. The opponent cannot choose that card again during this battle. They may choose one eligible replacement from the Reserve or pass.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Return your Active Mission to your Hand, then place another eligible Intelligence card from your Hand face down as your Active Mission. It cannot complete this turn.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, choose one: withdraw; or replace this card with an eligible card from your Hand, face up. If you replace it, put this card in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: During Onset in a battle you initiated, you may discard this card to reveal the opponent's Hand. You may then withdraw or continue the attack.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, you may withdraw.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after you win a battle you did not initiate while occupying an enemy-controlled Territory.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card and bind another card from your Hand to it face down.

effects.label: Asset
effects.text: At the end of each later turn, you may bind a card from your Hand to it face down, up to the number of Territories you control. Before an opposing effect causes this card to leave play, reveal its bound cards. You may play one whose Action effect can apply now without spending an Action. Discard the rest.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: During Opening or Denouement, as an Action, put this card in your Graveyard and reveal its bound cards. Play each whose Action effect can apply now, one at a time and in any order, without taking additional Actions. Discard the rest.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Reveal the opponent's Hand. Draw one card, then discard one card.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Before Tactics normally reveal, reveal each opposing face-down Tactic. You may then revise your own Tactics or withdraw. If you chose to remove this card as a Tactic, put it in your Graveyard.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after you reveal an opposing face-down battle card before its normal reveal, then win that battle.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When an opposing banked Asset's effect would apply, you may put this card in your Graveyard to negate that effect and put the opposing Asset in its owner's Discard Pile if it remains in play.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: Opposing banked Assets cannot be used during this battle.

effects.label: Mission
effects.text: Complete after you win a battle in which the opponent used a banked Asset and you used none of your banked Assets.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed in a battle involving you, before an opposing Battle effect applies, you may discard this card to choose one opposing Battle effect that has not taken effect. Negate it, then apply that printed effect as though you controlled it.

effects.label: Battle
effects.text: After Tactics are revealed, choose one opposing Battle effect that has not taken effect. Negate it, then apply that printed effect as though you controlled it.
